name: Sonja Koch
current_role_as_roster_published: Juge fédérale à la deuxième Cour de droit pénal
professional_history: Law studies in Zurich and Lausanne; admitted to the Aargau bar in 2004; doctorate in 2014.
Lawyer in Aarau; clerk in Lenzburg and at the Federal Supreme Court; scientific officer at the Federal Office of Justice.
President of the Bernese Jura-Seeland regional court (2014–2019); deputy federal judge (2018–2019).
case_explanation: Sat on the panel whose published judgment accepted consideration of the relatively short duration of a rape in sentencing. In 2024 the Court expressly disavowed that formulation.
